scope: Read-only single-strategy candidate catalogue and one scoped component-reservation retest. No production code, hardware policy, accepted board or master publication changed.

catalogue.command_basis: Use the carrier profile recipe in 2026-10-18-post-review-outline-screen.json at 161x150, omit --search-strategy and add --owned-selection-trace on. This is a baseline catalogue, not the qualified multi-strategy finalist.
catalogue.result: Baseline construction failed; catalogue and selection observations remain valid diagnostics, not board acceptance.
catalogue.selection_interpretation: Every selected USB-JTAG index names a contract-bottom single/pair variant, including rotated whole-sheet variants. A primary side of top is not evidence that all physical components are on top. These are repeated selection observations during failed attempts, not 108 accepted layouts.

qualified_reference_census.scope: Selected owner/support examples, not an exhaustive component census. Confirms both independent non-USB owner groups already use the bottom face.

component_reservation_retest.why_retest: The previous scoped reservation experiment on older source also encountered power-facing failures. Those policies have since been reviewed; this trial tests whether the remaining envelope restriction alone explains the smaller-outline failure.

next_algorithm_hypothesis.finding: append_contract_group_faces skips groups with required_top_refs before its group-rotation loop. Thus the optional group rotations only rotate bottom-side moves. Whole-sheet rotations exist, but do not independently rotate the top-pinned USB bridge/crystal group relative to other owners.
next_algorithm_hypothesis.experiment: Test independently qualified same-face rigid-group rotations while retaining top-side requirements, connector anchoring, local bypass/crystal relationships, exact pad geometry, incumbent preservation and complete operation accounting. Establish synthetic coverage and measure live catalogue/search cost before enabling any default.
next_algorithm_hypothesis.limits: This is a search-coverage hypothesis, not proof of smaller-board feasibility. No high-speed top-side rule was relaxed. Do not infer that more candidates necessarily improve search performance.

limits: Concurrent regression tests affect timings; no controlled speedup or matched Python comparison claimed. Failed candidates were not rendered or promoted. Qualified carrier remains 161x150, devkit 98x98; routing and unknown hardware requirements remain open.
